title: In vitro and in vivo assessment of sporopollenin exine capsule preparations (SpECs) from Lycopodium clavatum spores
content:

Ammar Hasan, Jeremiah Stanley, Abu Saleh Md Moin, Hamna Begam, Sana Waris, Marah Abdulhadi, Khaled Greish, Andrew N. Boa, Manyam Praveen Kumar, G. Roshan Deen, Stephen L. Atkin, Alexandra E. Butler
This study investigated the potential allergenicity of sporopollenin exine capsule preparations (SpECs) derived from plant pollen or spores as allergenicity could limit their use as a therapeutic oral drug delivery system.
